payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Afton, Clarissa, Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

payload.content: Planning update (Lenna): mobile-dev focused; availability 7h. I’m considering claiming ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, cost 1.46, medium) or ISSUE-0001::review (effort 2.0, cost 1.82, medium). Will avoid duplicates; please coordinate on remaining tasks.
If you plan to take ISSUE-0001 triage/review, let me know so I can choose a non-duplicated complementary task (docs/test) within 7h. I can’t do ISSUE-0002 implement (effort 8h > 7h).
Lenna note: medium-priority tasks are the same priority; to maximize joint score I’ll likely select the lowest-cost feasible among ISSUE-0001 triage/review. Await others to avoid duplicates.

Planning (Clarissa): mobile-development specialist, 7h available. I can take one task; feasible ones for me: ISSUE-0001 triage (effort 1.6, cost 1.71, medium) / review / docs / test / implement (4.0,4.26) ; ISSUE-0002 implement too big (8h) but review/test are low. I’ll avoid duplicating Lenna’s intended triage/review. If Lenna takes triage, I’m happy to take docs or test; if Lenna takes review, I can take triage or docs. Let’s coordinate to cover more tasks with minimal cost.

Clarissa suggestion: Lenna take ISSUE-0001::triage; I take ISSUE-0001::docs (or test if docs taken). That covers 2 tasks without duplicates and keeps my cost low. If Lenna instead takes review, I’ll take triage or docs accordingly.

Planning (Jessenia): mobile-development strongest skill, 4h available. Feasible medium tasks for me: ISSUE-0001::triage (effort1.6,cost1.65), review/docs/test (cost2.06/2.06/2.89), implement too large (4h exactly but higher cost4.13). Low tasks: ISSUE-0002::review (effort4h,cost4.13) or skip. I will coordinate to avoid duplicates; leaning to take ISSUE-0001::test or docs if not taken, otherwise skip.

Jessenia ask: Is Lenna taking ISSUE-0001::triage or review? If triage taken, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs (2h) or test (2.8h); if review taken, I can take docs/test. Please confirm to prevent duplicates.

Planning update (Elda): mobile-dev top skill, 8h available. To maximize coverage w/ low cost, I can take ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, cost 1.53) OR ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test if not taken. I’ll avoid duplicating whatever Lenna/Clarissa/Jessenia claim; please confirm intended assignments.

Elda preference: if triage already claimed, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 2.0, cost 1.91) next-best; if docs also claimed, I can take ISSUE-0001::review (effort 2.0, cost 1.91) or ISSUE-0001::test (2.8, cost 2.67). I won’t take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 8h, higher cost) unless nothing else is feasible.

Sheri planning: I’m mobile-dev focused (5h avail). Likely claim ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, prio medium) unless someone else already takes it; alternates ISSUE-0001::review or ::docs if needed. I will avoid duplicating triage/review if others coordinate. Please reply with your intended ISSUE-0001 task.

Afton planning: I’m considering taking ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, medium, cost 1.95) since it fits my 4h and is lowest effort for me. If Lenna/others take triage already, I’ll take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 2.0, cost 2.44) as fallback to avoid duplicates. Please reply with your intended claims so we cover max distinct tasks (phase=planning, iter=1).

[Lenna planning] I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, medium, cost 1.46) to cover the earliest lightweight item. Please have others avoid ISSUE-0001::triage; I’m leaving docs/test/review for others and will not take ISSUE-0002::implement (too big for 7h).

Clarissa planning (phase=planning): I understand Lenna takes ISSUE-0001::triage. I will avoid duplicating triage/review. My proposed claim is ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 2.0, medium, cost 2.13). If docs is taken, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8) as backup.

Jessenia: Confirming with Lenna—since Lenna will take ISSUE-0001::triage, I’m planning to claim ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 2.0, cost 2.06) if it’s not already taken; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, cost 2.89) or skip to avoid duplicates.

Elda planning: I see Lenna claims ISSUE-0001::triage and Clarissa/Jessenia intend ISSUE-0001::docs. To avoid duplicates, I will not take triage/docs. If still free, my best remaining medium task is ISSUE-0001::review (effort 2.0, cost 1.91); otherwise I’ll skip or take ISSUE-0001::test only if needed.

Sheri (planning): Lenna has triage; Clarissa/Jessenia expect docs; I will avoid duplicates by taking ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, medium) if available. If test is taken, next best is ISSUE-0001::review; otherwise skip. Please confirm any attempt to take test/review.

Afton (planning): confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::triage if available; aiming to avoid duplicate with Lenna who said they’ll take triage. If triage is already taken, my backup is ISSUE-0001::docs (not test/review) given my 4h limit and lowest feasible cost.
Lenna confirms: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Please avoid duplicate triage; allocate other ISSUE-0001 tasks among docs/review/test and avoid ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 8h > 7h).
Clarissa planning: Lenna will take ISSUE-0001::triage. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution (backup ISSUE-0001::test if docs unavailable) and will avoid any review/test duplicates accordingly.

Jessenia planning: Lenna confirmed ISSUE-0001::triage in execution, Clarissa intends ISSUE-0001::docs (backup test). To avoid duplicates, I plan to take ISSUE-0001::review if free; otherwise I’ll skip (to prevent overlapping with docs/test). Confirming for coordination.

Elda planning: since Lenna will take ISSUE-0001::triage and Clarissa/Jessenia intend ISSUE-0001::docs, I plan to claim ISSUE-0001::review in execution (effort 2.0, medium, cost 1.91). Please let others avoid review to prevent duplicates; otherwise I’ll skip.

Sheri planning: Lenna committed to ISSUE-0001::triage, Clarissa/Jessenia to docs, Elda to review. To maximize distinct completions and avoid duplicates, I will take ISSUE-0001::test if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I will skip (or take review only if somehow free, but expectation is it’s taken).

Afton planning confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, medium) in execution if unclaimed; otherwise fallback ISSUE-0001::docs. I’m coordinating to avoid any duplicate triage/docs claims.

[Planning broadcast] Lenna: confirming intent to take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (effort 1.6, cost 1.46, medium). Will not take any other task. Others: avoid duplicating triage; cover docs/review/test as planned; avoid ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 8h > 7h).

Clarissa planning (planning->execution): Lenna confirmed ISSUE-0001::triage. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution (backup ISSUE-0001::test only if docs is unavailable) and will avoid review/test duplicates to maximize distinct completions. Not taking any ISSUE-0002::implement (too large for 7h).

Jessenia planning: Lenna=ISSUE-0001::triage confirmed; Clarissa intends ISSUE-0001::docs. To avoid duplicates, I will NOT take review/test unless docs is unavailable. Tentative in execution: if docs already taken, I’ll skip; otherwise take ISSUE-0001::review (fits 4h).
Elda planning: confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution, with assumption triage=Lenna and docs=Clarissa (and test likely=Sheri). Please avoid claiming review to prevent duplicates.
Sheri planning on Blackboard 0: Lenna=triage, Clarissa/Jessenia=docs, Elda=review expected. I will target ISSUE-0001::test in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.

Afton (planning): confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::triage if unclaimed (Lenna already committed). To avoid any duplicate, I will only take triage in execution if it’s actually free; otherwise I will take ISSUE-0001::docs (backup) and will not take test/review. Please keep triage/docs allocation mutually exclusive.
